candidate_atomic_objectives.proposed_objective_text: Write decimal numbers as sums of powers of 2.
candidate_atomic_objectives.evidence_quote: To work with binary numbers, you need to be able to write a decimal number as the sum of powers of 2.
candidate_atomic_objectives.rationale: The textbook explicitly teaches and assesses decomposing decimal numbers into powers of 2 before full binary conversion. That prerequisite is measurable, but it is not equivalent to converting a base 10 numeral into a binary number.

candidate_atomic_objectives.proposed_objective_text: Convert binary numbers to base ten numbers.
candidate_atomic_objectives.evidence_quote: Convert binary numbers to base ten numbers
candidate_atomic_objectives.rationale: The textbook includes a worked example and exercises for binary-to-base-ten conversion. This is the reverse direction of the canonical AO and should be reviewed as a possible missing adjacent objective rather than silently linked to the base-ten-to-binary AO.
